target_profile.system_boundary: Captured Go Raft library. Algorithm and Ready bookkeeping are in scope; caller supplies transport, persistent IO and state-machine execution.
protocol_contexts: One local Raft instance with term, voter configuration and log

activities.purpose: Qualified support for decision formation and legal advancement
activities.realization_summary: Leader term-qualified quorum aggregation and follower prefix validation establish commit; heartbeat bounds and flow recovery preserve catch-up.

activities.purpose: Context validity and acquisition, transfer or loss of authority
activities.realization_summary: Term/vote elections, role resets and bounded leader transfer control authority; pending snapshot and unapplied configuration block campaigning.

activities.purpose: Recovery and resynchronization of eligible participation
activities.realization_summary: Snapshots replace divergent compacted history and restore membership; matching snapshots fast-forward commit; retries use heartbeat responses and transport reports.
Applied simple/joint changes preserve progress and determine both quorum eligibility and automatic exit responsibility.
Ready exports ordered committed work; completion advances applied accounting, with distinct async stable-boundary and snapshot restrictions.

activities.purpose: History, persistence and reconstruction of support
activities.realization_summary: Caller performs IO; library queues durability-dependent support, qualifies completion by issuance term and reconstructs stored state. MemoryStorage implements local storage operations.

activities.realization_summary: Node serializes events; RawNode caller serializes operations and consumes Ready. Proposal admission does not guarantee commitment.

facts.meaning: Local committed log prefix endpoint. Leader maybeCommit advances to a current-term entry supported by current voters. Follower append/heartbeat, accepted or matching snapshots, initialization from HardState and bootstrap also establish the endpoint under their separate guards.
facts.validity_context: Committed history persists across authority changes; this is not application completion or a guarantee of local physical durability at the instant of field update.
facts.durability: Caller persists Ready HardState and entries/snapshot. Field update and completed local persistence/application are separate boundaries.
facts.recovery: newLog initializes at compacted prefix; newRaft restores ConfState and in-range HardState commit, term and vote. Snapshot restoration establishes its committed index.

facts.meaning: The applied voter configuration is joint and assigns automatic exit to Raft. This flag records configuration state and responsibility; it does not assert that an exit proposal has been queued.
facts.validity_context: Current applied configuration with nonempty outgoing voter set and AutoLeave=true; survives term changes until configuration is replaced or joint state is exited.
facts.durability: ConfState saved in caller snapshot; committed configuration log entries reconstruct changes after snapshot.
facts.recovery: ConfState AutoLeave is reconstructed by confchange.Restore through EnterJoint.

Commit advancement here broadcasts but does not invoke pending-read release. Establish reachable pending requests and contract before testing.

formation.explanation: Leader assigns term/index, replicates entries, consumes persistence-qualified acknowledgments into Match, and commits a current-term quorum index. Followers match predecessor, repair uncommitted suffix, and learn commit; Ready hands committed entries to application. Heartbeats cap follower commit by known Match; rejection probes, empty appends after heartbeat responses and snapshots recover missing support. Application delivery excludes in-progress snapshots and, in async mode, unstable entries.

context.explanation: Pre-vote can precede real term increment; log freshness and voting restrictions qualify grants, current voter aggregation determines election. Higher terms normally force follower, with lease/pre-vote exceptions. Reset discards volatile support and active read tracking; committed log is retained. Startup restores durable term/vote and ConfState as follower. Snapshots reconstruct membership only when replacing the log; matching snapshots advance commit and leave configuration entries for normal application. Campaigning is blocked until committed configuration work and snapshots are handled. Transfers suppress proposals, catch up the target, and abort after electionTimeout if still leader.

connection.explanation: Support is interpreted under applied voter configuration and current leader term. New leader resets remote progress and appends an empty current-term entry before old history can advance through a new current-term commitment. Membership application can reinterpret existing support and directly advance commit. Persistence completion is a separate boundary from protocol receipt. Old-term storage append replies cannot stabilize replaced entries; later term-bearing append requests recover completion. Committed application/snapshot completion stays eligible across term changes. Joint changes retain both majorities and existing progress; automatic exit is triggered from application completion and may encounter transfer-time proposal rejection.
